name: Forecast reader
summary: Reads tomorrow's forecast for a city and says whether to take an umbrella.
does: Reads tomorrow's forecast for the city a caller names from the forecast service its owner binds, and says whether to take an umbrella. It reads and never writes.

offerings.name: Read the forecast
offerings.does: Reads tomorrow's forecast for the city the caller names and says whether to take an umbrella.

refusals:
Writing to the forecast service. It is granted read access only.
Reading anything from the forecast service but the forecast for the city it was asked about.

systems.name: forecast-service
systems.needs: to fetch tomorrow's forecast for the city the caller names
